items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1960-01-28
items.q: I think that's Metcalf, Larry Metcalf. Played pretty good.

ctx.x: I don't know who that is.
I'll tell you in a minute. I think that's Metcalf, Larry Metcalf. Played pretty good. The band's got a good beat. That's Larry Metcalf.
I don't know who that is. It's Charlie Moore. I wonder why that guy didn't ever take up clarinet.
